narration:
Hey everyone, it's time to ace those exams! 📚 In the heart of exam season, staying consistent can make all the difference. Meet Priya, a student who faced a big challenge. Hook

In the heart of exam season, staying consistent can make all the difference. Meet Priya, a student who faced a big challenge. Problem

Priya was overwhelmed with her studies and started to lose focus. She felt like giving up. Conflict

Priya was overwhelmed with her studies and started to lose focus. She felt like giving up. Turning point

But then, her teacher reminded her to stay consistent and not to rush. Priya decided to take it one day at a time. Resolution

With renewed focus, Priya managed to ace her exams. She proved to herself that consistency is key. Closing message

So, stay consistent, and you’ll ace those exams too! 🌟
